title: Markset conformance test file
description: One file per spec section. The file is an array of cases. See spec/v0.md §7.

section.description: Section identifier. Must equal the file's basename without .json.

name.description: Optional human-readable label used in harness reports.

markset.description: Input source. A full document for construct sections; the bare fragment for grammar sections.

html.description: Expected output of the HTML renderer. Omitted in grammar sections.

downgrade.description: Expected output of the downgrade renderer, as CommonMark. Omitted in grammar sections.

ast.description: Expected AST. Compared structurally, ignoring object key order. Required when valid is true.

valid.description: False when the parser must emit at least one error-severity diagnostic.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic code the parser must emit, errors and warnings alike, in any order. Absent means none.

code.description: Diagnostic code: an UPPER_SNAKE identifier whose first segment names the spec area.
